why: The reader says the main box reads "נשאר לכם בעוד 15 שנים" (left to you in 15 years) while the same box says "120 חודשים" (120 months), which is 10 years, and asks "Which is it?" That is a mismatch between the years under the result and the period entered. It is the first problem they raise in section 1, after comments that are not complaints, and they repeat it in blocks 6 and 5.
